$comment: The reading from the BUILT package given as data — see the comment beside `buildFixture` in tools/check-texts.mjs. Building an Angular package for every case would cost minutes per run, and the gate runs on every commit. `attributes` are the static name/value pairs exactly as the linker writes them into `ɵcmp.consts` and `ɵdir.hostAttrs`. A class is one object however often an entrypoint exports it: `exports` lists the names where they are not its own name once — `PctBlank` exported a second time as `PctBare`, which a correct package may do, and the reference passes.
